offering_description.value: Provides online and blended K-12 education: curriculum, technology and school operations for virtual public schools, plus career learning programs. Serves school districts, public charter schools, students and families, and adult learners and employers. Delivers through online platforms, instructional services and learning materials.

primary_products.value: online K-12 curriculum; learning software platforms; physical learning materials and computers for students

primary_services.value: virtual and blended school management; teacher and student support services; career learning programs; IT skills training and job placement; tutoring

customer_segment.value: B2G: public virtual and charter schools, school districts and state education agencies; B2B: employers and private schools, adult learners via career learning programs; B2C: families and students paying for private school and courses

end_markets.value: K-12 education; career and technical education; adult workforce training; healthcare and IT career training

revenue_model.value: service fees: funding from public schools per enrolled student for managed virtual school operations; product sales: curriculum, software and learning materials sold to schools and districts; project or contract: career learning and workforce training contracts with districts and employers; other: tuition from families for private school offerings
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; project or contract; other

value_chain_position.value: service provider: operates virtual schools and delivers instruction support for public schools and families; software / platform: develops online learning platform and curriculum licensed to schools

geography_served.value: US national: Virtual and blended schools across many US states, with some international private school offerings

specialization.value: related lines: general education K-12 programs and career learning programs sharing platform and curriculum

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts with public schools, districts and charter school boards; online: direct enrollment by families and adult learners through websites; partners / resellers: employer and healthcare partners for career training

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: State education regulations, charter authorizers, federal education rules, student privacy laws, and accreditation requirements
